text: 您好，我有嚴重的食物過敏。
back_translation: Hello, I have a serious food allergy.

text: 點餐前，請先仔細閱讀這張卡片。
back_translation: Before ordering, please first carefully read this card.

text: 我對以下食物過敏：
back_translation: I am allergic to the following foods:

text: 我的過敏很嚴重。即使只吃到極少量，也可能讓我嚴重發病。
back_translation: My allergy is very serious. Even eating only an extremely small amount may make me seriously ill (have a serious attack).

text: 這種過敏可能會危及生命。
back_translation: This allergy may endanger life.

text: 我有食物不耐症。雖然不會危及生命，但會讓我非常不舒服。
back_translation: I have a food intolerance. Although it is not life-threatening, it makes me very uncomfortable.

text: 這是醫療上的身體狀況，不是個人喜好。
back_translation: This is a medical physical condition, not a personal preference.

text: 謝謝您特別留意我的餐點。
back_translation: Thank you for paying special attention to my meal.

text: 花生
back_translation: peanut

text: 所有堅果，例如杏仁果、核桃、腰果和榛果
back_translation: all nuts (堅果: nuts in general), for example almonds, walnuts, cashews and hazelnuts

text: 杏仁果（美國杏仁）
back_translation: almond (杏仁果; 'American almond')

text: 榛果
back_translation: hazelnut

text: 核桃
back_translation: walnut

text: 腰果
back_translation: cashew

text: 胡桃（長山核桃）
back_translation: 胡桃 (walnut-family word; can be read as walnut / pecan) (pecan / 'long-mountain walnut')

text: 巴西堅果
back_translation: Brazil nut

text: 開心果
back_translation: pistachio

text: 夏威夷豆
back_translation: macadamia ('Hawaii bean')

text: 牛奶及所有乳製品
back_translation: cow's milk and all dairy products

text: 蛋
back_translation: egg

text: 魚
back_translation: fish

text: 甲殼類海鮮，例如蝦子、明蝦、螃蟹和龍蝦
back_translation: crustacean seafood, for example shrimp, prawns, crab and lobster

text: 軟體動物類海鮮，例如淡菜、蛤蜊、牡蠣（蚵仔）、魷魚和章魚
back_translation: mollusc seafood, for example mussels, clams, oysters (oyster / 蚵仔 small oyster), squid and octopus

text: 黃豆（大豆）
back_translation: soybean (yellow bean / soybean)

text: 麩質（小麥、大麥、黑麥，以及燕麥，除非有無麩質認證）
back_translation: gluten (wheat, barley, rye, and oats, unless certified gluten-free)

text: 小麥
back_translation: wheat

text: 芝麻
back_translation: sesame

text: 黃芥末（芥末籽）
back_translation: yellow mustard (mustard seed) [黃芥末 = yellow mustard; 芥末 alone in Taiwan often means wasabi]

text: 芹菜（包括根芹菜和芹菜鹽）
back_translation: celery (including celeriac and celery salt)

text: 羽扇豆粉和羽扇豆籽
back_translation: lupin flour and lupin seeds

text: 亞硫酸鹽
back_translation: sulphites

text: 松子
back_translation: pine nut

text: 椰子
back_translation: coconut

text: 蕎麥
back_translation: buckwheat

text: 玉米
back_translation: corn / maize

text: 豆類，例如扁豆、鷹嘴豆和豌豆
back_translation: beans / legumes (豆類), for example lentils, chickpeas and peas

text: 奇異果
back_translation: kiwi fruit

text: 紅肉及哺乳動物來源的吉利丁（明膠）（α-gal過敏症）
back_translation: red meat and gelatin (gelatine) from mammal sources (alpha-gal allergy)

text: 桃子及其他核果類水果，例如李子、杏桃和櫻桃
back_translation: peach and other stone fruits, for example plum, apricot and cherry

text: 蘋果
back_translation: apple

text: 香蕉
back_translation: banana

text: 芒果
back_translation: mango

text: 番茄
back_translation: tomato

text: 大蒜
back_translation: garlic

text: 洋蔥，包括青蔥和紅蔥頭
back_translation: onion, including green onion / scallion and shallot

text: 雞肉，包括雞高湯和雞粉
back_translation: chicken meat, including chicken stock and chicken powder (bouillon powder)

text: 豬肉，包括豬油和豬骨高湯
back_translation: pork, including lard and pork-bone stock

text: 吉利丁（明膠）
back_translation: gelatin (gelatine)

text: 味精（麩胺酸鈉）
back_translation: MSG ('taste essence', monosodium glutamate)

text: 這也包括用它製成的任何油、醬汁、醬料、粉、粉末、抹醬或裝飾配料。
back_translation: This also includes any oil, sauce, sauces/dips, flour, powder, spread or decorative topping made from it.

text: 請確認是否使用花生油，包括油炸用的油。
back_translation: Please confirm whether peanut oil is used, including oil for deep-frying.

text: 請確認醬料，例如沙嗲醬、青醬、墨西哥摩爾醬（mole）和果仁糖（praline）。
back_translation: Please check sauces, for example satay sauce, pesto (green sauce), Mexican mole and praline (nut candy).

text: 請確認甜點是否含有杏仁膏（美國杏仁製成）、牛軋糖或杏仁果粉（美國杏仁粉）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether desserts contain almond paste (made from almonds), nougat or almond flour (almond powder).

text: 請確認是否含有魚露或鯷魚，包括沙拉醬在內。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains fish sauce or anchovies, including in salad dressing.

text: 請確認是否含有蠔油或XO醬。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains oyster sauce or XO sauce.

text: 請確認是否含有蝦醬或蝦米。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains shrimp paste or dried shrimp.

text: 請確認是否含有魚高湯（例如日式高湯或柴魚片）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains fish stock (for example Japanese stock or bonito flakes).

text: 請確認是否含有醬油，醬油也含有小麥。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains soy sauce; soy sauce also contains wheat.

text: 請確認是否含有味噌、豆腐或豆醬。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains miso, tofu or bean paste.

text: 請確認是否含有海鮮醬、豆豉或豆類醬料。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains hoisin sauce ('seafood sauce'), fermented black beans or bean-based sauces.

text: 請確認是否含有麻油、芝麻醬，或在上面撒了芝麻。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains sesame oil, sesame paste, or has sesame sprinkled on top.

text: 請確認烹調時是否使用奶油、印度酥油、鮮奶油或起司。
back_translation: Please confirm whether butter (奶油: butter / cream), Indian ghee, fresh cream or cheese is used in cooking.

text: 請確認是否含有奶粉、乳清或酪蛋白。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains milk powder, whey or casein.

text: 請確認麵包或糕點表面是否刷了蛋液，以及麵糊裡是否有蛋。
back_translation: Please confirm whether the surface of bread or pastries was brushed with egg wash, and whether there is egg in the batter.

text: 請確認是否含有美乃滋和蒜味蛋黃醬（aioli）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains mayonnaise and garlic egg-yolk sauce (aioli).

text: 請確認是否用麵粉來勾芡醬汁或裹在食物外層。
back_translation: Please confirm whether flour is used to thicken sauces or to coat the outside of food.

text: 請確認高湯、湯底和調味粉的成分。
back_translation: Please confirm the ingredients of the stock, soup base and seasoning powder.

text: 請確認是否含有伍斯特醬（英國辣醬油），伍斯特醬含有鯷魚。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains Worcestershire sauce ('English spicy soy sauce'); Worcestershire sauce contains anchovies.

text: 請確認是否含有酒、醋或果乾（亞硫酸鹽）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains wine/alcohol (酒), vinegar or dried fruit (sulphites).

text: 即使是共用器具上殘留的極微量，也可能引起過敏反應。
back_translation: Even an extremely tiny amount left on shared utensils may cause an allergic reaction.

text: 請不要使用炸過我的過敏原的油或油炸鍋。
back_translation: Please do not use oil or a fryer that has fried my allergens.

text: 請使用乾淨的平底鍋、炒菜鍋和器具。
back_translation: Please use clean pans (flat-bottomed pans), woks and utensils.

text: 請使用乾淨的砧板和刀子。
back_translation: Please use a clean cutting board and knife.

text: 請不要用共用的烤架或鐵板來煮我的食物。
back_translation: Please do not use a shared grill or griddle (iron plate) to cook my food.

text: 準備我的餐點前，請先洗手並更換手套。
back_translation: Before preparing my meal, please first wash your hands and change gloves.

text: 請不要加任何我沒有確認過的盤飾、配料或醬汁。
back_translation: Please do not add any garnish, toppings or sauce that I have not confirmed.

text: 請將我的餐點分開準備、分開上菜。
back_translation: Please prepare my meal separately and serve it separately.

text: 把過敏原從做好的菜裡挑掉並不安全。請重新現做一份。
back_translation: Picking the allergen out of a finished dish is not safe. Please make a fresh one from scratch.

text: 因為自助餐的取菜餐具是共用的，所以我不能吃自助餐。
back_translation: Because the serving utensils at a buffet are shared, I cannot eat at the buffet.

text: 麵包店對我來說常常不安全，因為空氣中和檯面上都可能有麵粉和堅果。
back_translation: Bakeries are often not safe for me, because there may be flour and nuts in the air and on the counters.

text: 這道菜有含我的任何過敏原嗎？
back_translation: Does this dish contain any of my allergens?

text: 可以請您幫我跟廚師確認食材嗎？
back_translation: Could you please confirm the ingredients with the chef for me?

text: 可以讓我看一下食材的標示或包裝嗎？
back_translation: Can I take a look at the ingredient labels or packaging?

text: 這道菜是跟其他食物用同一鍋油烹調的嗎？
back_translation: Is this dish cooked in the same pot of oil as other foods?

text: 這道菜是跟其他食物用同一個鍋子或炒菜鍋烹調的嗎？
back_translation: Is this dish cooked in the same pot/pan or wok as other foods?

text: 醬汁裡有什麼成分？
back_translation: What ingredients are in the sauce?

text: 肉或魚有醃過嗎？醃料裡有什麼成分？
back_translation: Has the meat or fish been marinated? What ingredients are in the marinade?

text: 沙拉醬裡有什麼成分？
back_translation: What ingredients are in the salad dressing?

text: 甜點有含堅果、牛奶或蛋嗎？
back_translation: Does the dessert contain nuts, milk or egg?

text: 麵包有含牛奶、蛋、堅果或種子嗎？
back_translation: Does the bread contain milk, egg, nuts or seeds?

text: 這道湯是用什麼高湯做的？
back_translation: What stock is this soup made with?

text: 這是廚房自己做的，還是買現成的？
back_translation: Is this made by the kitchen itself, or bought ready-made?

text: 有哪些菜您可以安全地為我製作？
back_translation: Which dishes can you safely make for me?

text: 這道菜可以不加我的過敏原，重新現做嗎？
back_translation: Can this dish be made fresh again without adding my allergens?

text: 廚師有把握這道菜對我來說是安全的嗎？
back_translation: Is the chef confident this dish is safe for me?

text: 有任何食材標示「可能含有」我的過敏原嗎？
back_translation: Are any ingredients labelled 'may contain' my allergens?

text: 廚房有使用堅果或花生嗎？
back_translation: Does the kitchen use nuts or peanuts?

text: 油炸的食物是用共用的油炸的嗎？
back_translation: Are the fried foods fried in shared oil?

text: 是
back_translation: Yes

text: 否
back_translation: No

text: 我不確定
back_translation: I am not sure

text: 我去問廚師
back_translation: I'll go ask the chef

text: 可以，我們能安全地為您製作
back_translation: Yes (OK), we can safely make it for you

text: 不行，我們無法安全地為您製作
back_translation: No (not OK), we cannot safely make it for you

text: 這含有您的過敏原
back_translation: This contains your allergen

text: 這可能含有微量過敏原
back_translation: This may contain trace amounts of allergen

text: 我拿標示給您看
back_translation: I'll bring the label to show you

text: 我推薦這道菜
back_translation: I recommend this dish

text: 請點選您的回答。
back_translation: Please tap your answer.

text: 可以推薦一道對我來說安全的菜嗎？
back_translation: Can you recommend a dish that is safe for me?

text: 簡單的就好，例如只用簡單調味烤的肉或魚，配白飯或蔬菜。
back_translation: Something simple is fine, for example meat or fish grilled/roasted with only simple seasoning, with white rice or vegetables.

text: 請不要加醬汁。
back_translation: Please do not add sauce.

text: 請只用鹽、胡椒和橄欖油烹調。
back_translation: Please cook with only salt, pepper and olive oil.

text: 可以請您把食材寫下來給我嗎？
back_translation: Could you please write down the ingredients for me?

text: 如果您不確定，請直接告訴我。我寧可不點，也不想冒險。
back_translation: If you are not sure, please just tell me directly. I would rather not order than take a risk.

text: 請務必確認送到我面前的就是這一道菜。
back_translation: Please be sure to confirm that what is brought to me is this exact dish.

text: 上菜時，請跟我確認這就是那份針對我的過敏準備的安全餐點。
back_translation: When serving, please confirm with me that this is the safe meal prepared for my allergy.

text: 我只點飲料就好，謝謝。
back_translation: I'll just order a drink, thank you.

text: 可以讓我看一下過敏原資訊或過敏原菜單嗎？
back_translation: Can I see the allergen information or the allergen menu?

text: 我可以吃自己帶來的食物嗎？
back_translation: May I eat food I brought myself?

text: 非常感謝您的幫忙。
back_translation: Thank you very much for your help.

text: 我現在正在發生過敏反應。
back_translation: I am having an allergic reaction right now.

text: 請馬上幫我叫救護車。
back_translation: Please call an ambulance for me immediately.

text: 請告訴他們：「全身性過敏反應（過敏性休克），是一種嚴重的過敏反應。」
back_translation: Please tell them: 'Systemic (whole-body) allergic reaction (anaphylactic shock), a serious allergic reaction.'

text: 我的包包裡有腎上腺素自動注射筆。
back_translation: There is an epinephrine (adrenaline) auto-injector pen in my bag.

text: 請幫我使用它。
back_translation: Please help me use it.

text: 要打在大腿外側，可以隔著衣服直接打。
back_translation: Inject into the outer thigh; it can be injected directly through clothing.

text: 請幫我躺下。不要讓我站起來或走路。
back_translation: Please help me lie down. Do not let me stand up or walk.

text: 如果我呼吸困難，請扶我坐起來。
back_translation: If I have difficulty breathing, please help me sit up.

text: 如果5分鐘後沒有改善，可以再使用第二支自動注射筆。
back_translation: If there is no improvement after 5 minutes, a second auto-injector pen can be used.

text: 在救護人員到達之前，請留在我身邊。
back_translation: Please stay by my side until the ambulance personnel arrive.

text: 最近有急診的醫院在哪裡？
back_translation: Where is the nearest hospital with an emergency room?

text: 最近的藥局在哪裡？
back_translation: Where is the nearest pharmacy?

text: 請問您有抗組織胺藥錠嗎？
back_translation: Excuse me, do you have antihistamine tablets?

text: 請打電話給我的緊急聯絡人。
back_translation: Please call my emergency contact.

text: 這個產品有含我的任何過敏原嗎？
back_translation: Does this product contain any of my allergens?

text: 可以幫我看一下這個標示嗎？
back_translation: Could you help me read this label?

text: 標示上有寫「可能含有微量」過敏原嗎？
back_translation: Does the label say 'may contain traces of' allergens?

text: 有沒有不含我的過敏原的品牌？
back_translation: Is there a brand that does not contain my allergens?

text: 你們有賣不含過敏原的產品嗎？
back_translation: Do you sell allergen-free products?

text: 你們有賣無麩質的麵包或義大利麵嗎？
back_translation: Do you sell gluten-free bread or pasta (Italian noodles)?

text: 你們有賣不含堅果也不含黃豆的植物奶嗎？
back_translation: Do you sell plant milk that contains no nuts and also no soybean?

text: 請把我的過敏狀況告訴負責早餐的工作人員。
back_translation: Please tell the staff in charge of breakfast about my allergy condition.

text: 廚房可以為我準備一份安全的餐點嗎？
back_translation: Can the kitchen prepare a safe meal for me?

text: 我有嚴重的過敏。請不要給我任何我沒有確認過的餐點。
back_translation: I have a serious allergy. Please do not give me any meal I have not confirmed.

text: 可以請附近的乘客不要吃堅果或花生嗎？
back_translation: Could you ask nearby passengers not to eat nuts or peanuts?

text: 我必須隨時把過敏藥物帶在身上。
back_translation: I must carry my allergy medication on me at all times.

text: 我有醫師為我的藥物開立的證明信。
back_translation: I have a certificate letter issued by a doctor for my medication.
